summary: Frontend-only test of Touch Dragging. Used a Playwright context with has_touch=True, is_mobile=True and a 390x844 viewport, so matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)') was true. Touches were sent through the browser's real input path with CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent. Every requested scenario passed. (1) Hold a task card for 450-500ms: one .touch-ghost follows the finger, the source card gets .dragging, and the page and columns do not scroll natively during the drag. Dropping on the lower half of a card in the same column inserts after it ([4,5] became [5,4]). Dropping on the top half of a card in another column inserts before it (Done became [5,1,6]). Dropping on a column header with no card under the finger appends. Dropping into an empty column works. Order persisted after reload. (2) Column drag by header: the column gets .column-dragging and a ghost. A right-half drop placed col2 after col1 ([2,1,3] became [1,2,3]), a left-half drop placed it before, and the order persisted after reload. (3) A quick 175px swipe sideways or upward did not drag; the columns container or the window scrolled natively, with no ghost and no /move request. (4) page.tap on a task title opened the 'Edit task' modal, and a tap on column-menu opened 'Column settings', with no move requests. (5) Dropping a task or column on itself, or outside any column (topbar), sent no PATCH. A long press released without moving does nothing and does not open the modal. touchcancel cleans up the ghost and the drag state. (6) Auto-scroll works: holding at x=380 scrolled the columns container from 0 to 742, and holding at x=10 scrolled it from 500 to 0. (7) On touch, every card and column-head has draggable=false. On desktop at 1920 with a fine pointer they are draggable=true, and desktop HTML5 drag of a task (cross-column, after) and of a column (right half) still works and persists. (8) The activity API and the Activity panel list the touch moves ('moved X from In Progress to Done', 'reordered ... within', 'moved column ... to position N'). Member Jordan can touch-drag too. No console errors.

issues: There is no insertion indicator (placeholder or line) while touch-dragging. The user can't see whether the drop will land before or after the card under the finger. Only the dashed drop-ready column outline is shown.

At 390px a 310px column is only partly visible. Dropping a column 'after' its neighbour needs the finger on the neighbour's right half, which is often off-screen and depends on edge auto-scroll. It works, but it is fiddly.

action_items: Optional UX: show a drop placeholder or insertion line during touch drag (and desktop drag) so before/after is visible.
Optional: in dropColumn, skip the PATCH when the computed index equals the column's current index. Today a left-half drop on the right-hand neighbour sends a no-op PATCH /columns/:id/move.
Optional: add a 'contextmenu' preventDefault while a long-press is pending or active. Some Android browsers may show a context menu or haptic menu on a 350ms+ hold over the buttons inside a card.
critical_code_review_comments: BoardColumn.jsx computes TOUCH = isTouchDevice() once at module load. If the device changes pointer type (DevTools toggle, a hybrid device) the draggable attribute is not recomputed until reload. Minor.

useTouchDrag starts edge auto-scroll as soon as the drag activates. If the hold point is within 48px of the bottom or top viewport edge, the window starts scrolling immediately without the finger moving. Minor.
The ghost clone keeps data-task-id and data-column-id attributes. This is harmless because .touch-ghost has pointer-events:none, but removing them would be cleaner.

Implementation is clean otherwise: listeners are on window with passive:false, there is cleanup on unmount and touchcancel, touchend preventDefault stops the click after a drag, and the drop target is resolved with elementFromPoint.
seed_data_creation: None. Board 1 task and column order was changed by the tests (final order: columns [2 In Progress, 1 To Do, 3 Done], tasks In Progress [], To Do [5,3], Done [1,6,4,2]). The main agent said it will reset the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real touch works via CDP: cdp = await ctx.new_cdp_session(p); cdp.send('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', {type:'touchStart'|'touchMove'|'touchEnd'|'touchCancel', touchPoints:[{x,y}]}). Use a new context from page.context.browser.new_context(viewport=390x844, has_touch=True, is_mobile=True). Log in by POST /api/auth/login and setting localStorage 'token', then go to /board/1. Keep touch x between 48 and 342 to avoid edge auto-scroll, and set .columns scrollLeft beforehand so the source and target columns are both on screen. Native swipe scrolling also works with CDP touch moves.
